summary: Delivered product meets every acceptance criterion that tests can decide (npm test 439/439 re-run by this reviewer, ev:ev-muyrcykm-017b4a4f), and the eval dataset, holdout and thresholds still match the freeze (ev:ev-muyrdya6-016ba8f5). It does NOT meet Success Criterion 2 / AC8's enforced condition: the single recorded full-mode fallback eval (ev:ev-muyqzv9i-018cf19d) exits 1 with 24/25 checks because holdout high_urgency_recall = 0.571 (4/7) < 0.70 floor. The verification report states this honestly; RISK-12 is open with the user decision pending. Approval is not possible until that criterion is either met by evidence or formally amended by a recorded user decision.

criteria.description: npm test passes offline, every [T] AC covered by named tests (AC1-AC4, AC7-AC14, AC16, AC17; AC12 zero deps)
npm run eval (fallback) exits 0: every all-rows threshold AND every holdout floor met (AC8 / thresholds.json fallback.high_urgency_recall.holdoutMin 0.70)
Dataset minimum counts met and eval files match the pre-rules freeze sha256 (exactly one full-mode run recorded)
Live eval reported as NOT RUN without a key; live thresholds recorded as unverified; no live-quality claim

Injection: fallback injection_leak 0 failures in 27 with 3/N bound; injection_steer 2/23 (0.087) <= 0.25; in-family flag recall 1.000 >= 0.90; FPR 0.083 <= 0.10 (AC7); live injection NOT RUN; no ticket/key material in logs (AC10 tests)
Keyboard-only W1/W2 in <= 3 actions; AC5/AC6/AC15 browser inspection (contrast not tool-measured, disclosed)
package.json has zero dependencies and the app starts with a single command

findings.title: Approved Success Criterion 2 / AC8 holdout floor not met: holdout high_urgency_recall 0.571 (n=7) < 0.70
findings.detail: The only full-mode fallback eval (ev:ev-muyqzv9i-018cf19d, run once per E5) prints 'METRIC high_urgency_recall scope=holdout value=0.571 n=7 threshold=>=0.70 FAIL', 'RESULT FAIL 24/25', exit 1. The brief's Success Criterion 2 requires exit 0 with every holdout floor met, and thresholds.json enforces holdoutMin 0.70. Eval inputs are unchanged since freeze (ev:ev-muyrdya6-016ba8f5), so the miss is real, not a data artefact; tune-mode recall was 1.000, consistent with the overfitting RISK-4 anticipated. This is the user-safety-relevant metric (missed high-urgency tickets). RISK-12 is open with no recorded user decision. This reviewer did not and may not re-run full-mode eval (would be holdout run #2).
findings.recommendation: Resolution condition (either): (a) an explicit USER decision recorded (eccode decision) and linked on RISK-12 that accepts the fallback holdout high-recall miss as a known limitation and amends Success Criterion 2 / the AC8 holdout floor for this release (stating the accepted value 0.571, n=7, and that the fallback is a labelled safety net, not the classifier of record), with the report/checklist updated to cite that decision; OR (b) a recorded user decision authorising a rules revision to t11 (src/triage/fallback-provider.js) tuned on tune rows only, validated by a full-mode eval that exits 0 on a fresh, previously unseen holdout (or reported explicitly as holdout run #2 with the blindness caveat if the user accepts reuse), with new freeze hashes recorded before the rules change, plus npm test re-run passing.
